# UNHALT / formerly BATTERY
>  Reserve policy and controlled recovery for owned agents. Developer SDK v0.4 preparation; completed bounded mainnet canary.

## Documentation
- [Wallet power check](https://usebattery.xyz/check): actual finalized SOL/USDC plus your spending assumptions; no signing.
- [Power check contract](https://usebattery.xyz/developer/wallet-power.md): sources, arithmetic, privacy and limits.
- [Token status](https://usebattery.xyz/token): token details are under review; no CA or purchase links are displayed.
- [Direct paid work](https://usebattery.xyz/power): Exa x402 controller; live unpaid offer; paid canary awaits separate funding.
- [Paid resource runbook](https://usebattery.xyz/developer/paid-resource.md): exact vendor expense, floor, cap and recovery boundaries.
- [Research brief](https://usebattery.xyz/agents.md): hypothesis, evidence and limits.
- [Full text](https://usebattery.xyz/llms-full.txt): README, architecture, adapters and security.
- [Developer docs](https://usebattery.xyz/docs): reproduce actual inference and recovery.
- [Integrated execution](https://usebattery.xyz/developer/integrated-runtime.md): completed interleaved local/mainnet run;3 actual calls/3 finalized settlements, same-signature recovery and all principal returned.
- [Paid-provider adapter](https://usebattery.xyz/developer/paid-provider.md): one actual request/recovery/readback; report rejected, authoritative billing unverified.
- [Pricing](https://usebattery.xyz/pricing): proposed $9/active-agent/month; unavailable for purchase.
- [Costs and commercial hypothesis](https://usebattery.xyz/developer/pricing.md): free SDK; hosted pricing, paid costs and revenue unvalidated.
- [OpenAPI](https://usebattery.xyz/openapi.json): fixed read-only devnet API.

## Evidence
- [Actual local AI run](https://usebattery.xyz/evidence/live-agent.json): dated inference, crash and recovery.
- [Mainnet financial proof](https://usebattery.xyz/mainnet):8 finalized transactions,3 test settlements,crash/recovery,revoke and5USDC return.
- [Financial artifact](https://usebattery.xyz/evidence/mainnet-canary.json): signatures,wire hashes,exact USDC deltas,negative simulations and verifier.
- [Canary runbook](https://usebattery.xyz/developer/mainnet.md): bounded USDC delegation, safety and return path.
- [Human proof](https://usebattery.xyz/evidence): event trail and browser hash check.
- [Anchor status](https://usebattery.xyz/evidence/devnet-anchor-status.json): unconfirmed; faucet refused test SOL.
- [GitHub source](https://github.com/sproutagentai/battery-agent-reserve): public SDK repository.
- [Source kit](https://usebattery.xyz/battery-pilot-kit.zip): SDK, tests and website source.

## Boundary
Actual local inference/devnet reads; paper USD/browser simulations. Eight mainnet canary transactions are finalized; test transfers bind saved results, not paid-model billing. Three negative mainnet checks in each run were preflight simulations. New integrated proof: https://usebattery.xyz/evidence/integrated-financial.json; model/event trail: https://usebattery.xyz/evidence/integrated-runtime/integrated.json. No hosted paid agent,vault or independent BATTERY audit. Project token status: https://usebattery.xyz/token.
